summary: Main page button grid + Settings accordion — faster navigation on every screen
whatsNew: Main page buttons reorganized into a 2-column grid with 4 labeled groups: Logging, Planning, Analytics, and Manage & Data — cuts scroll height roughly in half

Settings modal now uses a collapsible accordion — tap any section header to expand or collapse it. Patient Profile opens by default; all other sections start collapsed so you can jump straight to what you need
fixes: openSettingsAtEvents() now auto-expands the Daily Schedule section when navigating directly to Events from elsewhere in the app
